Sender identity flows from _msgSender into _transfer fee/limit checks.
msg.sender is compared against privileged addresses inside _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance accounting.
approve stores allowance with _msgSender() as owner.

manualswap authorization depends on comparing msg.sender to fee addresses.
manualsend authorization depends on comparing msg.sender to fee addresses.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter consumed only by _transfer's checks and balance updates.
to is a parameter consumed only by _transfer's checks and balance updates.
amount is a parameter consumed only by _transfer's limit checks and transfer math.
takeFee is a local flag used only by _tokenTransfer to control fee handling.
tokenAmount is a parameter used only by swapTokensForEth for approval and swap input.
maxTxAmount parameter flows directly into the owner-only transaction limit setter.
maxWalletSize parameter flows directly into the owner-only wallet size setter.
swapTokensAtAmount parameter flows directly into the owner-only threshold setter.
_tradingOpen parameter flows directly into the owner-only trading toggle.
bots_ array parameter flows directly into the owner-only blacklist function.
notbot parameter flows directly into the owner-only unblacklist function.
account parameter flows directly into the owner-only preTrading setter.
allowed boolean flows directly into the owner-only preTrading setter.
